kyoto_gion_yamaoka.gf_detail: Ask. Seasonal kappo with dashi and soy, sashimi and shabu-shabu; no gluten information is published (reviews).
kyoto_gion_yamaoka.vegan_detail: Not vegan: courses of crab, fish and meat (reviews).
kyoto_gion_yamaoka.hours_raw: 19:00–24:00; closing days vary (Tabelog). Cards and e-money accepted (Tabelog). An 8-seat counter; non-smoking, with a smoking area (Tabelog). On Gion-machi Minamigawa south of Shijo (Tabelog). About ¥20,000–40,000 a head (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_gion_yamaoka.notes: [Kappo · Gion south of Shijo, eight-seat counter] An intimate eight-seat counter where a smiling, bow-tied chef lets top ingredients speak with minimal seasoning — matsuba crab sashimi, nodoguro shabu-shabu, a hot pot with hana-sansho. About ¥20,000–40,000; from 7 pm.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers (2025–2026) describe a bow-tied chef with a ready smile, humble and charming, cooking live at the counter in a stylish, calm room.

anecdotes.text: A May 2025 guest singled out the small hot pot with hana-sansho.
A February 2026 cook of ten years praised its “seasoning by subtraction”.
A March 2026 diner had the last matsuba crab of the season as sashimi.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 祇園山岡、日本料理、京都市東山区祇園町南側570-246、19:00〜0:00、定休日不定、カード・電子マネー可、カウンター8席、禁煙 (喫煙所あり)、予算30,000〜40,000円ほど。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 蝶ネクタイの笑顔の大将、花山椒の小鍋、肉の火入れ、引き算の味付け、菜の花と山椒のいか、鯛と赤貝のお造り、松葉蟹の刺身、のどぐろのしゃぶしゃぶ、落ち着いたおしゃれな店内、1人20,000〜40,000円ほど。

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through March 2026.

kyoto_gion_sushi_faro.gf_detail: Ask. An April 2026 reviewer says the brothers accommodate gluten-free requests; mention it when booking, as soy sauce and seasonings are not otherwise described (review B525889708).
kyoto_gion_sushi_faro.hours_raw: 16:00–23:00 (last food order 21:00, drinks 22:00) Monday–Saturday, holidays, holiday eves and the day after a holiday (Tabelog); Sunday is not stated. Course only (April 2026). Cards (incl. UnionPay); no e-money (Tabelog). A 10-seat counter; non-smoking (Tabelog). Prime Building 2F, Gion-machi Kitagawa, a short walk from Gion-Shijo (Tabelog; May 2026). Opened 1 November 2025 (Tabelog).
kyoto_gion_sushi_faro.notes: [Sushi · Gion north of Shijo, brothers’ omakase] A sleek ten-seat counter opened in November 2025 by two Tokyo-trained brothers who speak English and Spanish: a ¥15,000 omakase with uni and caviar, 8–10 nigiri, and a ¥4,500 sake pairing from a sake sommelier. Gluten-free requests accommodated, per a review — ask when booking.

chef_bio.background: Opened in November 2025 (Tabelog) by two brothers who trained at a well-known Tokyo sushi restaurant and speak English and Spanish; one is a sake sommelier (April and May 2026 reviews).

anecdotes.text: An April 2026 solo diner took the ¥15,000 course with the ¥4,500 sake pairing and noted the gluten-free accommodation.
A May 2026 guest began with an uni “cocktail” of top-grade sea urchin.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 祇園鮨FARO、寿司・天ぷら・すき焼き、京都市東山区祇園町北側347-153 プライムビル2F、月〜土・祝日・祝前日・祝日の翌日 16:00〜23:00 (料理L.O.21:00、ドリンクL.O.22:00)、カード (銀聯も)、電子マネー不可、カウンター10席、禁煙、2025年11月1日オープン。口コミ (2026年、英語): 東京の名店で修業した兄弟、英語とスペイン語が堪能、コースのみ、雲丹とキャビアの特選おまかせ15,000円 (前菜、刺身、雲丹のカクテルなど季節の一品、握り8〜10貫、お椀、雲丹は蟹に替えられる)、日本酒ペアリング4,500円、利き酒師、京都の日本酒とワイン、グルテンフリーにも対応。

cultural_comfort.note: The chefs speak English and Spanish (2026 reviews).

existence.note: Tabelog listing (opened 1 November 2025); reviews dated April and May 2026.

kyoto_manina.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Risottos are rice-based, but the menu also has lasagna, sandwiches, chiffon and lemon cakes and granola (2023–2025 reviews).
kyoto_manina.vegan_detail: Ask. An April 2024 reviewer had an avocado sandwich labelled vegan; most other dishes use cheese, cream, eggs, sausage or meat sauce.
kyoto_manina.hours_raw: Tabelog: Wed–Sun 11:00–19:00 (food L.O. 17:00); closed Monday and Tuesday. No reservations. Mainly a grocery shop selling ingredients, sauces, frozen risottos and sweets from the Italian restaurant cenci, with eat-in at one table for about 6–7 (2023–2024 reviews). Cards and e-money. Also an online shop. On Nijo-dori east of Kawabata, about 8 min from Keihan Sanjo or Jingu-Marutamachi.
kyoto_manina.notes: [Grocery café · Kawabata-Nijo, cenci's shop and table] The bright grocery shop of the acclaimed Italian restaurant cenci: browse its pantry goods, then sit at the one big table for a generous risotto, lasagna or cacao chiffon with coffee or natural wine. An avocado sandwich has been labelled vegan. About ¥1,500–3,000. Closed Mon and Tue.

chef_bio.background: A shop run by the Italian restaurant cenci (kyoto_cenci_shogoin in this guide), selling the ingredients, sauces and sweets used there; a December 2025 reviewer calls it cenci's second shop. A November 2023 visitor from Tokyo was served by the wife of cenci's chef Sakamoto, who opened on a closed day for her. A December 2022 reviewer credits the cacao chiffon to cenci's pâtissier Nakatsuka.
chef_bio.specialty: cenci's risottos, sauces and cacao sweets.

anecdotes.text: August 2023: "While the restaurant's course meal includes smaller portions of risotto, I believe the dine-in servings at manina are about 2 to 3 times larger—definitely enough for a full meal."
April 2024: "I tried the avocado sandwich labeled as vegan… Despite its simple seasoning, it was delicious."
June 2025: "It's not really a place for lingering."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: manina、その他、左京区難波町211-5、京阪三条・市役所前・神宮丸太町から徒歩8分、水〜日11:00〜19:00 (料理L.O.17:00)、月・火休み、予約不可、7席、カード・電子マネー可。口コミ (2022年12月〜2025年12月、英語): イタリア料理店cenciの食材店で、店内で食事もできる (大きなテーブル1卓)、れんこんのボロネーゼのリゾットとスープ、ソーセージのリゾット、ラザニア、ホットサンド、ヴィーガン表示のアボカドのサンド (2024年4月)、アマゾンカカオのシフォンケーキ900円、レモンケーキ、イートンメス、カカオ餅のモンブラン1,200円、丹波栗のモンブラン、自然派ワイン、cenciのシェフSakamoto氏の妻が接客 (2023年11月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Mostly a shop; one shared table; staff explain the products.

positives: An April 2024 reviewer had an avocado sandwich labelled vegan.

existence.note: Tabelog listing with reviews dated 2025 to March 2026.

kyoto_aozora_hanten.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: wheat noodles (nira soba, chuka soba, tantanmen), gyoza, spring rolls, fried bread and soy-based sauces (2026 reviews).
kyoto_aozora_hanten.vegan_detail: Not vegan: chicken-and-pork broths, chashu, gyoza, shrimp and pork dishes; even the fried eggplant comes from a meat-heavy kitchen (2026 reviews).
kyoto_aozora_hanten.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon–Sat and public holidays 15:00–24:00 (L.O. food 23:00, drinks 24:00); closed Sunday; hours may change. October 2026 reviewers came at lunch for a newly added lunch set (ramen and a mini chashu bowl), so check Instagram for lunch days. Charge: 「無し、ただしワンドリンク必須（＝フードのみの利用不可）」 (no charge, but one drink per person is required — food-only orders are not allowed; Tabelog Japanese original). Prices shown before tax (April 2026). Counter and tables; smaller "just-size" portions of many dishes (November 2026). Cards: JCB (Tabelog); QR codes. Tabelog says no reservations, though a May 2026 reviewer booked ahead and found it full. In a renovated old house in the old Gojo-Rakuen quarter, near the Ume-yu bathhouse; 7 min from Kiyomizu-Gojo.
kyoto_aozora_hanten.notes: [Neighbourhood Chinese · Gojo-Rakuen, a late-night machi-chuka] A buzzy, nostalgic-style Chinese diner in an old house near the Ume-yu bathhouse, open to midnight: heaps-of-chives nira soba, gyoza with house chili oil, tomato-egg stir-fry and chili-shrimp fried rice, many in small portions. One drink each required. About ¥2,000–3,500. Some dishes run salty. Closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Opened 17 March 2026 (March 2026 review). A May 2026 reviewer writes that the owner of the popular Gojo café "Kissa Jani" opened it in a renovated old house, recreating an old-style neighbourhood Chinese diner, and that older regulars from the nearby bathhouse drop in for gyoza and beer. A November 2026 diner counted a staff of four.
chef_bio.specialty: Nira soba; gyoza; late-night Chinese plates.

anecdotes.text: May 2026: "Kissa Jani's owner has taken the next step by opening a local Chinese restaurant that stays open late into the night."
November 2026: "We topped the fried rice with the leftover chili shrimp sauce—This was mind-blowingly delicious!"
September 2026: "The Sweet and Sour Pork and Mapo Tofu were too salty, overshadowing the natural flavors of the ingredients… In contrast, the Tenshinhan had a perfect balance."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: あおぞら飯店、ラーメン・中華料理、下京区菊屋町317、清水五条から徒歩7分、月〜土・祝日15:00〜24:00 (L.O.料理23:00・飲み物24:00)、日曜休み、予約不可の表示、チャージ「無し、ただしワンドリンク必須（＝フードのみの利用不可）」、カウンターあり、カード (JCB)・QR可。口コミ (2026年3〜11月、英語): 2026年3月17日開店、Kissa Janiの店主の町中華、古い家を改装、梅湯の近く、にらそば950円、特製中華そば1,000円、餃子と自家製ラー油、春巻き、なすの素揚げ、トマトと卵の炒め物、かにとレタスのチャーハン、エビチリ、オムライス、担々麺、税抜き表示、ハーフサイズあり、10月には昼のセットも、塩辛い料理があるとの声 (2026年5月・9月)、カツカレーは物足りない (2026年4月)。

cultural_comfort.note: One drink per person required; small portions available; open late.

existence.note: Tabelog listing (opened March 2026) with reviews dated March to November 2026.

kyoto_teuchi_soba_inoue.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: the soba is ni-hachi — 80% buckwheat, 20% wheat flour (December 2024, December 2025) — plus tempura bowls and soy-based dipping sauce.
kyoto_teuchi_soba_inoue.vegan_detail: Not vegan: soba in broth or with dipping sauce, chicken nanban soba, duck soba, oyakodon and charcoal yakitori (2022–2026 reviews); no vegan information.
kyoto_teuchi_soba_inoue.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon–Sat 17:30–22:00 (L.O. 21:30), open on public holidays; closed Sunday, the 3rd Monday and the 5th Saturday of the month; closes early when the soba sells out; occasional temporary closures. 2022 reviewers ate weekday lunch here, but current Tabelog hours are evenings only. Reservations taken. 24 seats; non-smoking. Cards, e-money and PayPay. A soba izakaya: soba plus charcoal yakitori and small dishes at night. Orders can take 30+ minutes (March 2026). Down a lantern-lit alley off Matsubara-dori east of Shinmachi; about 10 min walk from Gojo or Shijo stations.
kyoto_teuchi_soba_inoue.notes: [Soba izakaya · Matsubara-Shinmachi, handmade soba and yakitori] A lantern-lit alley doorway leads to a roomy, regular-filled soba house: start with a drink and charcoal yakitori, then finish with crisp ni-hachi zaru soba (¥1,080) or duck soba. About ¥3,000–5,000 at night. Evenings only; closed Sundays. Can be slow when busy.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers describe a shop full of regulars and kind staff — one lent a guest an umbrella in the rain (May 2022) — with soba made on site in a visible soba-making room (December 2025). One March 2026 diner waited over 30 minutes for food; others find it a little pricey but worth it.

anecdotes.text: December 2025: "The well-prepared ni-hachi soba (80% buckwheat, 20% wheat flour) is delightful… The dipping sauce leans towards Edo-style, but rather than being sharp, it emphasizes a lingering umami flavor."
May 2022: "On my way back, it started to rain, and the kindness of the staff who offered me an umbrella was heartwarming."
March 2026: "The downside was that I had to wait over 30 minutes from ordering to receiving my food."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 手打ち蕎麦 井上、そば・居酒屋・日本料理、下京区松原通新町東入中野之町168-2、四条・五条駅から徒歩15分 (五条から440m)、月〜土17:30〜22:00 (L.O.21:30)、祝日は通常営業、日曜・第3月曜・第5土曜休み、そばがなくなり次第終了、臨時休業あり、予約可、24席、禁煙、カード・電子マネー・PayPay可。口コミ (2022年5月〜2026年3月、英語): 二八そば、ざるそば1,080円、おろしそば1,100円、鴨ねぎのつけそば、天ぷら丼、鶏南蛮そば、刻み揚げと九条ねぎのそば、ミニ親子丼、そばがき、炭火焼き鳥 (もも・ハツ・砂肝・つくね・せせり)、そば焼酎、常連客が多い、2022年は昼も営業、提供まで30分以上 (2026年3月)。

existence.note: Tabelog listing with reviews dated December 2025 to March 2026.

kyoto_teppan_dining_lajitto.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: teppan courses end with French toast, and include soups, a seafood foil bake and Japanese-style ankake (2024–2026 reviews); no gluten information.
kyoto_teppan_dining_lajitto.vegan_detail: Not vegan: Miyazaki beef and jidori chicken teppanyaki courses with sea bream, seafood and roast beef (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_teppan_dining_lajitto.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon, Tue, Thu–Sun 11:30–15:00 (L.O. food 14:00) and 17:30–22:00 (L.O. food 21:00); closed Wednesday. Reservations taken; message plates for celebrations free on request (March 2026). Lunch courses about ¥3,500–4,000+; dinner courses around ¥10,000. 24 seats: counter on the 1st floor, tables on the 2nd, private rooms for 2–8. Children's plate available (November 2024). Non-smoking; wheelchair accessible. Cards and QR codes. In a converted house by Yanagibanba-Nijo, 6 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae.
kyoto_teppan_dining_lajitto.notes: [Teppanyaki · Yanagibanba-Nijo, Miyazaki beef in a townhouse] A calm house-turned-teppan bar where the chef grills Miyazaki beef and seasonal fish at the counter, finishing with temari sushi or garlic rice and a famous French toast. Lunch courses from ¥3,500, dinner about ¥10,000. Free message plates for celebrations. Closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers describe a hidden teppan restaurant in a private house, with a 1st-floor counter and 2nd-floor tables (November 2024), chefs who explain each dish (February 2025) and regulars who return every year for birthdays. One April 2025 diner found the temari sushi bland and hoped the service would match the food.

anecdotes.text: January 2025: "The sea bream carpaccio wasn't just a thin slice; it was thick and satisfying sashimi… And the meat was truly outstanding!"
March 2026: "I had requested a message on a dessert plate in advance, and it was beautifully presented… (And it was a complimentary service!)"
April 2025: "The temari sushi was adorable and a delight to the eyes, but it was flavorless."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: Teppan Dining L’ajitto、ステーキ・鉄板焼き・日本料理、中京区柳馬場二条西入ル等持寺町1-7、京都市役所前から徒歩6分、月・火・木〜日11:30〜15:00 (料理L.O.14:00)・17:30〜22:00 (料理L.O.21:00)、水曜休み、予約可、24席、個室 (2〜8名)、禁煙、車いす可、カード・QR可、適格請求書の登録番号T2130001044337 (国税庁の公表サイトでは株式会社アイセラ、京都市下京区)。口コミ (2024年11月〜2026年8月、英語): 民家の鉄板焼き、1階カウンター・2階テーブル、宮崎牛、昼のコース3,500円から、手まり寿司、ガーリックライス、フレンチトースト、10,000円のコースに鯛のカルパッチョ・海鮮のホイル焼き・地鶏、デザートのプレートにメッセージ (無料)、持ち帰りのハンバーグサンド、手まり寿司は味が薄いとの声 (2025年4月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Chef cooks in front of you and explains each dish; celebration plates on request.

existence.note: Tabelog listing with reviews dated 2025 to August 2026.

kyoto_cafe_sunaba.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: a bread breakfast — salt bread, chocolate and raisin breads (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_cafe_sunaba.vegan_detail: Not vegan: breads served with butter and jam (February 2025); no vegan item sourced.
kyoto_cafe_sunaba.hours_raw: Breakfast daily except Wednesday 7:00–11:00; Friday also 18:00–23:00; closed Wednesday; may change (Tabelog). Cards and e-money (Tabelog). Up narrow stairs to a bright second-floor room in what looks like an ordinary house; easy to miss without the sign (December 2024, February 2025). English-speaking staff (February and May 2026). Near Sanjo Keihan (Tabelog).
kyoto_cafe_sunaba.notes: [Breakfast café · near Sanjo Keihan] The upstairs breakfast room of the bakery Le bac a sable (listed separately): from 7:00, a ¥600 set of two breads — salt, chocolate or raisin — with butter, jam and coffee or cocoa, in a bright wooden room with English-speaking staff. Mornings only, plus Friday evenings; closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog and reviews: a café opened 21 November 2024 as the sister shop of the Higashiyama bakery Le bac a sable (December 2024, February and September 2025).

anecdotes.text: A February 2025 early riser climbed the narrow stairs for the ¥600 set — salt bread with chocolate bread and salt bread with raisin bread, coffee, jam and butter.
A September 2025 visitor took the owner’s advice of salt bread, then agonised between chocolate chip and raisin before choosing raisin.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: カフェ、左京区菊鉾町297-6、月火木土日7:00〜11:00、金7:00〜11:00・18:00〜23:00、水曜休み、カード・電子マネー可、2024年11月21日オープン。口コミ (2024年12月〜2026年5月、英語): 東山のパン屋 Le bac a sable (ルバカサブル) の姉妹店、フランス人のオーナー、狭い階段で2階へ、普通の家のような外観、パン3種から2つとドリンクの朝食セット600円 (塩パン、チョコ、レーズン、バターとジャム)、ココア、英語を話すスタッフ。

cultural_comfort.note: English-speaking staff (February and May 2026). Look for the sign — the café is upstairs in a house.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through May 2026.

kyoto_cafe_sunaba.pin_source: Tabelog https://tabelog.com/en/kyoto/A2601/A260302/26042614/ (35.011531, 135.775129); cross-checked: GSI 京都府京都市左京区菊鉾町297番地 (lot) 60m; 2026-11-08

kyoto_cafe_karin_chionin.gf_detail: Ask. The spice curry comes with vegetables and multigrain rice (March 2025, February 2026), but the curry base is not described; cakes are wheat (October 2026). No allergen information.
kyoto_cafe_karin_chionin.vegan_detail: Some vegan options: a vegan spice curry with a plate of vegetable sides (March and April 2025). Whether the 2026 spice curry is the same vegan recipe is not stated — ask. Soft serve and cakes are not vegan.
kyoto_cafe_karin_chionin.hours_raw: Daily 8:30–19:30; may change (Tabelog). Self-service: order at the counter (February 2026). Eat in or take away (2021 review). 32 seats (Tabelog). On the ground floor of 和順会館, Chion-in’s lodging, beside its souvenir shop, facing the Sanmon gate; the temple itself closes at 17:00 (February 2026); café described on the shop site.
kyoto_cafe_karin_chionin.notes: [Café · Chion-in] A self-service café in Chion-in’s Wajun Kaikan facing the great Sanmon gate, open from 8:30 to 19:30: a vegan spice curry with vegetable sides, cake sets, soft serve, coffee and matcha beer — a handy stop before or after the temple.

chef_bio.background: Per the shop site and reviews: the café of 和順会館, the lodging of Chion-in, head temple of the Jodo sect, beside its souvenir shop (2024–26 reviews).

anecdotes.text: A March 2025 lunch visitor chose the vegan curry, topped with assorted vegetables and served with a plate of sides — light enough for a small appetite.
An April 2025 visitor, starving at 16:30 before a meeting, had the vegan spiced curry with a matcha beer.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: カフェ、東山区林下町400 知恩院 和順会館1F、毎日8:30〜19:30、32席。口コミ (2025年3月〜2026年10月、英語): 知恩院の三門の前、和順会館の土産物売り場の横、セルフサービス、ヴィーガンのスパイスカレーと野菜の副菜、雑穀米のスパイスカレー、ソフトクリーム、チョコレートケーキとチーズケーキのセットと抹茶ラテ、ブレンド500円、抹茶ビール、寺は17時に閉まる。

cultural_comfort.note: Self-service — order and pay at the counter. Ask whether the day’s curry is the vegan one.

existence.note: Shop site; Tabelog reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_the_bridge_cafe.gf_detail: Ask. Most food is wheat — muffins, hot sandwiches, toast, pizza, pasta — but a rice-flour carrot cake is served (December 2025, March 2026); whether it is wheat-free is not stated.
kyoto_the_bridge_cafe.vegan_detail: Not vegan: ham-and-cheese breakfast sets with egg and yogurt, pork curry, cheesecake (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_the_bridge_cafe.hours_raw: Tue–Sat 7:30–16:00 (food last order 14:30, drinks 15:30); Sunday 7:30–12:00 (food last order 9:30); closed Monday (Tabelog). Order and pay at the counter first (December 2025). Power outlets at many seats (December 2024, February 2026). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). A renovated machiya with a courtyard at Muromachi-Takatsuji, just west of Karasuma (October 2025, February 2026).
kyoto_the_bridge_cafe.notes: [Machiya café · Muromachi-Takatsuji] A spacious renovated machiya with a courtyard and power outlets, open from 7:30 for muffin, hot-sandwich and toast breakfast sets, then spice curry, pasta and pizza at lunch, and a warm rice-flour carrot cake. Run by a church. Closed Monday; Sundays to noon.

chef_bio.background: Per reviews: a café in a renovated Kyoto townhouse, run by the HPC church (December 2025); the curry comes from another curry shop (June 2025).

anecdotes.text: A May 2025 couple, searching for the nearest early breakfast, found it opened at 7:30 and had ham-and-cheese hot sandwich and muffin sets with salad, half an egg and yogurt.
A March 2026 visitor praised the ¥650 carrot cake, served slightly warmed so the inside stayed fluffy.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: カフェ、下京区高辻町587、火〜土7:30〜16:00 (料理L.O.14:30・ドリンクL.O.15:30)、日7:30〜12:00 (料理L.O.9:30)、月曜休み、カード・電子マネー・QR 可。口コミ (2025年5月〜2026年8月、英語): 町家を改装、中庭、電源席、先に注文と支払い、キリスト教会 HPC の運営、ハムとチーズのマフィンやホットサンドのセット (サラダ、ゆで卵半分、ヨーグルト、ドリンク)、チーズトースト、チーズとベーコンのピザ1,300円、ほかのカレー店のスパイスカレー (ポークとキーマ)、パスタ、米粉のキャロットケーキ650円、抹茶のチーズケーキ、室町高辻、烏丸の少し西。

cultural_comfort.note: Order and pay at the counter, then take a seat. No English evidence found.

kyoto_common_bal_gojo.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: fried chicken (yurinchi, chicken nanban, tulip chicken), gyoza, spring rolls, curry and craft beer (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_common_bal_gojo.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a meat-focused menu — fried chicken, sausages, gyoza; set meals with miso soup (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_common_bal_gojo.hours_raw: Weekdays 11:00–14:00 (last order 13:30) and 17:00–22:00 (last order 21:00); weekends and holidays 15:00–22:00 (last order 21:00); closing days vary (Tabelog; shop site). 「サービス料＋チャージ料なし」 — no service or cover charge (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). 27 seats at tables, partitioned four-seat tables by the door (Tabelog; August 2025). Busy at the lunch peak (June 2026). Ground floor of a building with a co-working space upstairs, about five minutes from Gojo Station (August 2025, June 2026).
kyoto_common_bal_gojo.notes: [Meat & craft beer · Gojo-Karasuma] A casual meat-and-craft-beer bar near Gojo-Karasuma: weekday set-meal lunches — yurinchi, chicken nanban, curry, daily special — with rice, miso soup and salad, then gyoza, spring rolls, sausages and tulip chicken with beer in the evening. Formerly Common Dining; the long-time chef left in May 2026.

chef_bio.background: Per the shop site and reviews: run by 共栄商事株式会社; formerly コモンダイニング (Common Dining), whose long-time chef left in May 2026 (May 2026 review); renamed common bal.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the shop site: 「「いつもの」がある場所」 — a place for your usual.

anecdotes.text: A June 2026 regular, usually on the daily special, recommends the chicken nanban or special curry sets, each with rice, miso soup, a side and salad.
An October 2026 evening diner singled out the shrimp spring rolls and tulip chicken dressed with bonito flakes.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 運営は共栄商事株式会社、「いつもの」がある場所、こだわりの肉料理とシェフ自慢の創作料理、平日11:00〜14:00・17:00〜22:00、土日・祝日15:00〜22:00。食べログ: バル・肉バル・居酒屋、下京区玉津島町294 1F、L.O.は昼13:30・夜21:00、休みは不定、サービス料＋チャージ料なし、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、27席、旧店名コモンダイニング。口コミ (2025年8月〜2026年10月、英語): 油淋鶏、チキン南蛮、特製カレー、日替わり、ご飯・味噌汁・小鉢・サラダ付き、2026年5月に長年のシェフが退く、2階はコワーキングスペース、五条駅から徒歩約5分、夜は海老の春巻き、餃子、ソーセージ、かつお節のチューリップ。

cultural_comfort.note: Come just before or after the noon peak for lunch. No English evidence found.

existence.note: Shop site; Tabelog reviews dated through October 2026, after the May 2026 chef change.

kyoto_hiiragi_nijo.gf_detail: Not GF for most dishes: cream croquettes, beef cutlet, omurice with demi-glace and fried ayu involve wheat (2025–2026 reviews). Carpaccio and grilled pork may suit — ask.
kyoto_hiiragi_nijo.vegan_detail: Not vegan: meat, seafood and egg dishes (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_hiiragi_nijo.hours_raw: Monday–Saturday 12:00–14:30 (last order 14:00) and 17:30–22:00 (last order 21:30); closed Sunday (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). The chef cooks alone, so allow time (November 2025). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, UnionPay), IC cards, iD, QUICPay and QR (PayPay, d Barai, au PAY, Alipay) (Tabelog). 20 seats: 8 at the counter, 12 at tables; non-smoking; school-age children welcome; solo diners welcome (Tabelog; January 2026). SD Building 2F, up a narrow spiral staircase; 8 min walk from Karasuma-Oike Stn (Tabelog; November 2025). Opened 17 February 2025 (Tabelog).
kyoto_hiiragi_nijo.notes: [Yoshoku and wine · Nijo-Yanaginobamba] Up a spiral stair to a bright, airy room where a solo chef turns out creative yoshoku — crab cream croquettes, Sasuke pork, beef cutlet, a fluffy demi-glace omurice at lunch — with organic wine. Solo-friendly counter. Closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog and reviewers: a Western-style restaurant opened 17 February 2025 on the second floor of the SD Building, where the chef — named Inoue by a September 2026 regular — runs the kitchen alone (November 2025), cooking seasonal ingredients with care.
chef_bio.philosophy: Creative Western dishes of seasonal ingredients, carefully prepared (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 regular, back for a girls’ night, was won over again by Chef Inoue’s generous appetiser platter and Seiko crab cream croquettes.
A November 2025 lunch guest read a book while the solo chef prepared a beef-tendon demi-glace omurice.
A February 2026 solo traveller chose it over a wine bar the night before a sushi booking.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: バル・洋食・肉料理、中京区二条通柳番場西入観音町85-1 SDビル 2F、烏丸御池駅から徒歩8分、月〜土 12:00〜14:30 (L.O.14:00)、17:30〜22:00 (L.O.21:30)、日曜休み、予約可、カード (VISA・Master・JCB・AMEX・Diners・銀聯)・交通系IC・iD・QUICPay・QR (PayPay・d払い・au PAY・Alipay) 可、20席 (カウンター8、テーブル12)、禁煙、小学生以上可、2025年2月17日開店、紹介文 (英訳): らせん階段を上った大人の隠れ家、旬の食材の創作洋食。口コミ (2025年9月〜2026年10月、英語): シェフの Inoue さん、一人で調理、昼は4種 (牛すじのデミグラスのオムライス1,800円、サラダ付き)、前菜の盛り合わせ (しらすと新玉ねぎのスペイン風オムレツ、Sasuke 豚の自家製ローストハムのサラダ)、せいこがにのクリームコロッケ、Sasuke 豚のグリル、ビーフカツ、イカスミのリゾット、さんまのカルパッチョ、鮎のフライとパクチーのソース、生ハム、オーガニックのワイン。

cultural_comfort.note: Spiral stairs; solo chef — allow time; cards and QR.

kyoto_watanabeya_oshikoji.gf_detail: Ask. Plain-grilled offal may suit, but sauces and the motsunabe broth likely use soy, and ramen is wheat (2018–2026 reviews). No gluten information.
kyoto_watanabeya_oshikoji.vegan_detail: Not vegan: yakiniku and beef-offal hot pot (2018–2026 reviews).
kyoto_watanabeya_oshikoji.hours_raw: Weekdays 18:00–24:00; Sunday and holidays 17:30–23:00; closed the 1st and 3rd Tuesday; hours may change (Tabelog). Saturday is not stated and Tuesday is closed two weeks a month, so both are left out of the hours. Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Cash only (Tabelog). 12 seats per Tabelog (a May 2025 reviewer counted three tables of four and two of two); smoky, Showa-era room (Tabelog; November 2018). On a corner with a red lantern, 3 min walk from Karasuma-Oike Stn (May 2025).
kyoto_watanabeya_oshikoji.notes: [Yakiniku and motsunabe · Oshikoji-Karasuma, cash only] A tiny, smoky Showa-style corner under a red lantern: grill some horumon, then move on to the house motsunabe, finishing with ramen and zosui in the broth. Fills up fast. Cash only.

chef_bio.background: Per reviewers: a long-running, compact yakiniku shop on an Oshikoji corner near Karasuma-Oike, with a nostalgic Showa feel and a motsunabe many prefer to the grill (2017–2026 reviews).

anecdotes.text: An April 2018 first customer of the night started the tecchan-nabe for two and snacked on raw senmai while it heated.
A May 2025 diner who counted 16 seats said it really does fill up, and preferred the motsunabe to the grilled meat.
An August 2026 first-timer ended the motsunabe with both ramen and zosui.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 焼肉・ホルモン・鍋、中京区押小路通烏丸東入西押小路町109-2、平日 18:00〜24:00、日・祝日 17:30〜23:00、第1・第3火曜休み、予約可、カード不可、12席、子ども可。口コミ (2017年6月〜2026年8月、英語): 角の赤ちょうちん、昭和レトロで煙もくもく、ホルモンと焼肉、生センマイ、てっちゃん鍋 (もつ鍋) と豆腐、しめのラーメンと雑炊、4人掛け3卓と2人掛け2卓で16人 (2025年5月)、すぐ満席。

cultural_comfort.note: Cash only; small and smoky; book.

kyoto_shoraku_nishinotoin.gf_detail: Not GF: wheat udon in dashi, tempura, curry udon (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_shoraku_nishinotoin.vegan_detail: Not vegan: dashi broth, meat udon, oyakodon and tempura (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_shoraku_nishinotoin.hours_raw: Monday and Wednesday–Saturday 11:00–14:30; closed Tuesday and Sunday; hours may change (Tabelog). Lunch only. No reservations; queues, often of overseas visitors, of 20–30 minutes and shared tables (Tabelog; March–August 2026). Cards (AMEX per Tabelog); no e-money or QR. 22 seats at six tables; non-smoking (Tabelog). Run by a couple (March 2026). On Nishinotoin-dori just north of Bukkoji; 7 min walk from Shijo Stn.
kyoto_shoraku_nishinotoin.notes: [Udon · Nishinotoin-Bukkoji, lunch only] A small couple-run udon shop with a gentle Kyoto dashi and chewy handmade noodles — niku udon with kayaku rice, nabeyaki, curry udon — and warm, attentive service. Expect a queue. Closed Tuesday and Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Per reviewers: a long-loved lunchtime udon shop run by a couple, praised for warm hospitality and good ingredients, now drawing queues of visitors from abroad (March–August 2026).

anecdotes.text: A December 2025 retiree travelled back after three years for the niku udon and kayaku rice, calling it the best in Kansai.
A March 2026 last-meal-in-Kyoto waited nearly 30 minutes in a queue of overseas visitors and wondered why.
A May 2026 regular found the old kara-age and ginger-pork sets gone, and had a mini oyakodon set instead.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: うどん・そば・丼、下京区西洞院通仏光寺上る綾西洞院町758-2、四条駅から徒歩7分、月・水〜土 11:00〜14:30、火・日休み、予約不可、カード (AMEX) 可、電子マネー・QR 不可、22席 (2人掛け2卓、4人掛け3卓、6人掛け1卓)、禁煙。口コミ (2025年12月〜2026年8月、英語): 夫婦で営む、手打ちうどん、やさしいだし、肉うどんとかやくご飯、肉カレーうどん (お揚げ入り)、鍋焼きうどん、ぶっかけうどん、天ぷらの冷やしぶっかけセット1,600円、ミニ親子丼やミニ玉子丼のセット、海外の客の行列、相席、温かい接客。

cultural_comfort.note: Queue at lunch; shared tables; lunch only.

kyoto_tsukitokage_shinmachi.gf_detail: Not GF: a tempura izakaya of wheat batter; oden and fish cakes in soy dashi (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_tsukitokage_shinmachi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: seafood and pork tempura, fish and dashi oden; vegetable tempura shares the fryer (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_tsukitokage_shinmachi.hours_raw: Tuesday–Sunday and holidays 17:00–23:00 (last orders food 22:00, drinks 22:30); closed Monday (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners) and PayPay; no e-money (Tabelog). 49 seats: a 1F counter facing the fryer, tatami and private rooms for 4–8 (Tabelog; February–September 2026). Smoking allowed (Tabelog; April 2025). Take-out (Tabelog). Shinmachi-dori just north of Sanjo; 5 min walk from Karasuma-Oike Stn.
kyoto_tsukitokage_shinmachi.notes: [Tempura and oden · Sanjo-Shinmachi] A friendly, good-value izakaya where tempura is fried by the piece at the counter — shrimp, lotus root, chestnut — alongside oden, homemade satsuma-age and a signature fried tofu, with plenty of sake. Smoking allowed. Closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site and reviewers: the tempura izakaya of ツキトカゲ, a two-shop name whose main shop serves charcoal yakitori near Tomikoji-Nijo (tsukitokage.com); a friendly owner and a counter where guests watch tempura being fried (October 2025; September 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Tempura by the piece; fried-tofu starter.

anecdotes.text: A December 2024 diner who loves red-ginger tempura found it here, with eggplant, for just ¥30.
A January 2025 visitor chose it over a nearby oden shop on a cold Friday, drawn by the charming roadside sign.
A September 2026 regular brings family and friends to sit at the 1F counter and watch the tempura fried.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 居酒屋・天ぷら、中京区町頭町108 (新町通三条上ル)、烏丸御池駅から徒歩5分、火〜日・祝日 17:00〜23:00 (L.O.料理22:00、飲み物22:30)、月曜休み、予約可、カード (JCB・AMEX・Diners)・PayPay 可、電子マネー不可、49席、4〜8名の個室、座敷、喫煙可、テイクアウト、公式サイトあり。公式サイト: 「炭火焼鳥 ツキトカゲ本店」(二条通富小路東入晴明町672-2) と「天ぷら呑み屋 ツキトカゲ新町店」の2店。口コミ (2024年12月〜2026年9月、英語): 1本ずつ揚げる天ぷら (えび、なす、さつまいも、豚ヒレ、モンゴウイカ、栗、れんこんのはさみ揚げ、新玉ねぎ、紅しょうが)、名物の揚げ豆腐、おでん (大根、卵、厚揚げ)、自家製さつま揚げ、のどぐろ、だし巻き、焼き飯、日本酒10種ほど、気さくな店主、1階のカウンター。

cultural_comfort.note: Counter by the fryer; smoking allowed; cards and PayPay.

kyoto_shubo_nana_yatacho.gf_detail: Ask. Obanzai, sashimi, salt-grilled wagyu, tamagoyaki and fried chicken; no gluten information (2025 review).
kyoto_shubo_nana_yatacho.vegan_detail: Not vegan: sashimi, wagyu, chicken, duck and egg dishes (2025 review).
kyoto_shubo_nana_yatacho.hours_raw: Monday–Saturday and the days before and after public holidays 17:00–22:00; closed Sunday and public holidays; closed 28 December–4 January (Tabelog). Cards: VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 16 seats (Tabelog). Non-smoking (Tabelog). A red lantern in a narrow side alley (February 2025; September 2026).
kyoto_shubo_nana_yatacho.notes: [Izakaya · back-alley red lantern, run single-handed] A small, old-school red-lantern izakaya down a quiet side alley, where the owner cooks and serves alone: obanzai, sashimi, salt-grilled wagyu, tamagoyaki and fried chicken, with easy conversation at the counter. Closed Sunday and holidays.

chef_bio.background: A February 2025 reviewer describes a one-person operation, with a friendly, chatty owner cooking efficiently. No operator was found.

anecdotes.text: A February 2025 group on a second round found it quiet while the main streets were packed, and chatted with a fellow guest from Kanagawa.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 酒房菜々、居酒屋、下京区矢田町114-2、月〜土・祝日の前日・祝日の翌日 17:00〜22:00、日曜・祝日定休、年末年始 12月28日〜1月4日休み、カード可 (VISA・Master・JCB・AMEX)、電子マネー・QR不可、16席、禁煙。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 昭和レトロ、路地の赤提灯、店主一人で切り盛り、気さくな店主、おばんざい5種、刺身の盛り合わせとわさび漬け、和牛の塩焼き、玉子焼き、唐揚げ、鴨もある。

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated February 2025 and September 2026.

kyoto_ippodo_honten_kaboku.gf_detail: Ask. Teas in the Kaboku tea room come with a Japanese sweet chosen from a box of about four kinds; no ingredient information for the sweets (2026 reviews).
kyoto_ippodo_honten_kaboku.vegan_detail: Ask. Matcha, gyokuro, sencha and hojicha are plant-only, but the accompanying wagashi are not described as vegan (2026 reviews).
kyoto_ippodo_honten_kaboku.hours_raw: Shop and Kaboku tea room 10:00–17:00 (tea room last orders 16:30); closed the second Wednesday of each month and over New Year (own site; Tabelog). Cards and e-money; no QR (Tabelog). Non-smoking; parking (Tabelog). Takeaway drinks for strolling (own site). Tea-brewing classes upstairs (own site; Tabelog). Product prices revised in October and November 2026 (own site). On Teramachi-dori north of Nijo, about 6 min on foot from Kyoto-Shiyakusho-mae (own site; August 2026).
kyoto_ippodo_honten_kaboku.notes: [Tea room · Teramachi-Nijo, tea merchant since 1717] The historic main shop of Ippodo, in business since 1717, with its Kaboku tea room beside the sales floor: matcha, gyokuro or hojicha brewed for you and served with a seasonal sweet, plus takeaway drinks and tea leaves to buy. Busy with visitors; staff explain the teas. Closed second Wednesdays. Flagged: one family company with other shops and department-store counters.

chef_bio.background: Founded in 1717 as the tea and pottery shop 近江屋 by 渡辺利兵衛 (reading not sourced) from 近江; given the name 一保堂 by 山階宮 (reading not sourced) in 1846; moved to the present Teramachi-Nijo site after the shop burned in 1864; turned from tea exporter to retailer in the Taisho era; the Kaboku tea room opened in 1995 with four tables. The site says successive heads of the house have carried the shop on (own site).
chef_bio.philosophy: The name means “to keep to tea alone” (own site).

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 visitor buying for a tea-loving friend in America was walked through gyokuro and sencha by a staff member and left with several teas.
An October 2026 family tried koicha, gyokuro and hojicha in the tea room, each served with a sweet.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 一保堂茶舗 京都本店／喫茶室 嘉木、10:00〜17:00 (喫茶L.O. 16:30)、毎月第2水曜定休、年末年始は別営業、テイクアウトあり、喫茶室は奥の間・カウンター席・寺町の間、2階でお茶の教室、2026年10月・11月に価格改定。歩み: 享保2年 (1717) 近江出身の渡辺利兵衛が「近江屋」を創業、弘化3年 (1846) 山階宮より「一保堂」の屋号を賜る、元治元年 (1864) 蛤御門の変で焼失後に寺町通二条上ルの現在地へ、明治は輸出問屋、大正に小売へ、昭和27年 阪神百貨店へ出店、平成7年 (1995) 喫茶室 嘉木オープン、代々の当主が店を受け継ぐ。食べログ: 中京区二条上ル常盤木町52、カード・電子マネー可、QR不可、禁煙。口コミ (2026年、英語): 薄茶「Kyogoku no Mukashi」と和菓子1,760円、濃茶、玉露、ほうじ茶、冷たい抹茶、テイクアウトのほうじ茶と「Frozen Uji Shimizu」、本店限定の Special Sencha 90g 3,402円、「Masaike no O」80g 1,296円、くき茶1,188円、いり番茶。

cultural_comfort.note: Many overseas visitors; staff explain the teas.

existence.note: Own site and Tabelog listing; reviews dated June to October 2026.

kyoto_viva_takka_karasuma_oike.gf_detail: Ask. Pasta, lasagna, pizza, focaccia, fried gnocco and a salmon cutlet, alongside teppan-grilled meats and salads; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
kyoto_viva_takka_karasuma_oike.vegan_detail: Ask. Organic vegetables from Ishii Farm and a build-your-own pasta with a choice of sauce and vegetables, but nothing is described as vegan (2026 reviews).
kyoto_viva_takka_karasuma_oike.hours_raw: Daily incl. public holidays: lunch 11:30–15:00 (last orders 14:30), dinner 17:00–23:00 (last orders 22:30) (Tabelog). Opened 22 July 2026 (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and QR incl. Alipay and WeChat Pay (Tabelog). 24 seats incl. counter and sofa seats; standing parties up to 40 (Tabelog). Non-smoking, smoking area outside; wheelchair accessible (Tabelog). Near Karasuma-Oike station (August and September 2026).
kyoto_viva_takka_karasuma_oike.notes: [Italian bar · Karasuma-Oike, opened 2026] A casual Italian bar near Karasuma-Oike: pasta lunches from ¥1,400 with a choice of sauce, and in the evening teppan-grilled meat platters, creative small plates with organic vegetables and build-your-own pasta, with wine and cocktails. Open daily. Flagged: third shop of a small local group (京酒場 団らん, ネオ酒場 団らん); operator not found.

chef_bio.background: Opened on 22 July 2026 (Tabelog). A September 2026 reviewer calls it the third shop after the izakaya 京酒場 団らん in Saiin and ネオ酒場 団らん on Nishioji. No operator was found.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 diner was surprised to find venison alongside beef and pork on the three-meat platter, and enjoyed picking every element of a custom pasta.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: Viva takka、イタリアン、中京区室町通御池下る円福寺町342-1 VOISE21ビル 1F、毎日 11:30〜15:00 (L.O. 14:30)・17:00〜23:00 (L.O. 22:30)、2026年7月22日オープン、カード・電子マネー・QR (Alipay、WeChat Pay含む) 可、24席、立食40名、禁煙 (店外に喫煙所)、車椅子可。口コミ (2026年、英語): Ishii Farm の有機野菜と鉄板焼きの肉の創作イタリアンバル、パスタランチ1,400〜1,600円 (前菜、サラダ、パン、3種のソースから選ぶ)、前菜の盛り合わせ1,500円、生ハム1,100円とニョッコフリット500円、レアサーモンカツ1,300円、鹿肉入りの3種の肉の盛り合わせ、カスタムパスタ、ピザ、鯛と茄子のタルタル、イチジクとマスカルポーネ、京酒場 団らん (西院)・ネオ酒場 団らん (西大路) に続く3店舗目。

cultural_comfort.note: Casual; many payment options incl. Alipay and WeChat Pay.
